scope: Two real-model conversion attempts with localized bounded failure; no successful real-model conversion or inference

measurement.method: Python subprocess.Popen for each CLI process, blocking os.wait4(pid, 0) for per-child resource usage, time.monotonic for elapsed time
measurement.cache_state: Source SHA-256 was computed immediately before each attempt; source file pages may be warm. No cold-cache or statistical performance claim.
measurement.tool_note: /usr/bin/time was unavailable; its initial launch failed before starting a converter. Measurements use wait4 instead.

budgets.other_read_limits: ReadLimits::default(); full resolved options retained in each raw log
